description: Domain architecture of TIN-44 from AlphaFold pLDDT profiles compared with yeast Tim44 and human TIMM44, plus the consolidated evidence table
code:
# Final analysis: the N-terminal domain of TIN-44, the region that in yeast Tim44 carries the
# mtHsp70 and Tim23 contacts. Test whether TIN-44 shows the same two-part architecture
# (low-confidence extended NTD + high-confidence folded CTD) as yeast and human.
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, json
HD={"User-Agent":"Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64)"}
def txt(u):
    r=requests.get(u,headers=HD,timeout=180); r.raise_for_status(); return r.text
accs={"YEAST Tim44 (Q01852)":"Q01852","HUMAN TIMM44 (O43615)":"O43615","WORM TIN-44 (O02161)":"O02161"}
# AlphaFold DB: resolve the current model URL through the API, then download
models={}
for lab,a in accs.items():
    meta=json.loads(txt(f"https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/{a}"))[0]
    models[lab]=txt(meta["pdbUrl"])
    print(lab, meta["pdbUrl"].split("/")[-1])

def ca_plddt(t):
    res={}
    for l in t.split("\n"):
        if l.startswith("ATOM") and l[12:16].strip()=="CA":
            res[int(l[22:26])]=float(l[60:66])
    return pd.Series(res).sort_index()
pl={k:ca_plddt(v) for k,v in models.items()}
# CTD start taken from the crystallised constructs / alignment: yeast 234, human 266, worm 241
ctd={"YEAST Tim44 (Q01852)":234,"HUMAN TIMM44 (O43615)":266,"WORM TIN-44 (O02161)":241}
rows=[]
for k,s in pl.items():
    c=ctd[k]
    # mature-protein start: skip the predicted presequence (first 40 residues) for the NTD stat
    ntd=s.loc[41:c-1]; cterm=s.loc[c:]
    rows.append(dict(protein=k, length=int(s.index.max()),
                     presequence_1_40=round(float(s.loc[1:40].mean()),1),
                     NTD_41_to_CTD=round(float(ntd.mean()),1),
                     pct_NTD_below_70=round(100*float((ntd<70).mean()),1),
                     CTD=round(float(cterm.mean()),1),
                     pct_CTD_above_90=round(100*float((cterm>90).mean()),1)))
T=pd.DataFrame(rows)
print("\n=== AlphaFold pLDDT by region ===")
print(T.to_string(index=False))

# Where does the ordered part begin in each protein? first residue after which 20 consecutive CA have pLDDT>70
print("\n=== first position of a sustained ordered stretch (20 consecutive CA with pLDDT > 70) ===")
starts={}
for k,s in pl.items():
    v=(s>70).values; idx=s.index.values; st=None
    for i in range(len(v)-20):
        if v[i:i+20].all(): st=int(idx[i]); break
    starts[k]=st
    print(f"  {k:26s} residue {st}  (CTD construct starts at {ctd[k]}; 8E1M models yeast Tim44 from 107)")

fig,axes=plt.subplots(3,1,figsize=(9,7.5),sharex=False)
for ax,(k,s) in zip(axes,pl.items()):
    c=ctd[k]
    ax.plot(s.index,s.values,lw=1.1,color="#2b6cb0")
    ax.axhline(70,ls=":",c="grey",lw=.8)
    ax.axvspan(1,40,color="#c05621",alpha=.25,label="predicted presequence 1-40")
    ax.axvspan(41,c-1,color="#ecc94b",alpha=.30,label="N-terminal domain")
    ax.axvspan(c,s.index.max(),color="#68d391",alpha=.30,label="C-terminal NTF2-like domain")
    ax.set_ylim(0,100); ax.set_ylabel("pLDDT"); ax.set_title(k,fontsize=10)
    ax.legend(fontsize=7,loc="lower right",ncol=3)
axes[-1].set_xlabel("residue")
fig.suptitle("All three Tim44 orthologues share one architecture: a low-confidence extended\nN-terminal domain followed by a high-confidence folded C-terminal domain",fontsize=11)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

# consolidated evidence table written as provenance
summary=pd.DataFrame([
 ["AlphaFold model quality","TIN-44 AF-O02161 CTD mean pLDDT",f"{T.loc[T.protein.str.startswith('WORM'),'CTD'].iloc[0]}","computed this iteration"],
 ["CTD fold","TIN-44 model vs human 2CW9 chain A, Kabsch with outlier rejection","1.13 A over 157/179 CA","computed iteration 1"],
 ["CTD fold","TIN-44 model vs yeast 2FXT chain A","1.46 A over 133/186 CA","computed iteration 1"],
 ["CTD fold","independent check, phenix.superpose_pdbs","1.224 A","computed iteration 1"],
 ["Hydrophobic cavity","1PE probe atoms from 2CW9 transformed into the TIN-44 frame","cavity open, no steric clash","computed iteration 1"],
 ["Membrane helix","A1/A2 max Eisenberg moment, worm 245-262","muH 0.562, 99th percentile of own CTD","computed iteration 2"],
 ["Membrane helix","A1/A2 max Eisenberg moment, human 270-287 / yeast 240-257","0.582 / 0.495","computed iteration 2"],
 ["TIM23 interface","yeast->worm identity at 41 8E1M contact residues","22% vs 27.4% background, OR 0.72, p 0.465","computed iteration 2"],
 ["TIM23 interface","yeast->human control","32% vs 28.6% background, OR 1.18, p 0.716","computed iteration 2"],
 ["Nematode conservation","median CTD identity to TIN-44 across 26 nematode genera","65.2%","computed iteration 1"],
 ["Worm experimental evidence","PubMed for TIN-44 localization / HSP-6 interaction / phenotype","none found","iteration 2"],
], columns=["feature","test","result","provenance"])
summary.to_csv("tin44_evidence_summary.csv",index=False)
print("\n=== consolidated computed evidence ===")
print(summary.to_string(index=False))
